page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core, operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. This architecture delivers dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading, ensuring consistent execution patterns for memory-bound workloads.

The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. For local storage, it includes a 237 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, providing high-speed, low-latency local block storage directly attached to the host. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Because this instance utilizes ARM64 architecture, software compatibility is limited to operating systems and applications compiled for ARM. It does not include dedicated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The combination of high memory density, dedicated ARM cores, and fast local NVMe storage makes the r9gd.xlarge highly suitable for memory-intensive applications, local caching layers, relational databases, and low-latency data processing tasks that benefit from ephemeral local storage.
